text: ***Trance.*** You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

effects.note: Immunities: no need to sleep; magic can't cause sleep.
